AS

 --   DECLARE @p_user_id			    NVARCHAR(30)		= N'iamarock';
 --   DECLARE @debug_mode			    NVARCHAR(1)			= N'F';


    SELECT	  A.DIVISION_ID

            AND A.PLANT_ID      <> '-'
            AND A.FACTORY_ID    <> '-'
            AND A.LINE_ID       <> '-'
    GROUP BY  A.DIVISION_ID

			, A.FACTORY_ID
			, A.LINE_ID
    ORDER BY  A.DIVISION_ID
			, A.COMPANY_ID
			, A.SITE_ID
	    	, A.PLANT_ID
    		, A.FACTORY_ID
		    , A.LINE_ID
